mechanics.label: Aardvark Worm Interception
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Unrezzed Aardvark opens a Corp choice after Worm use on the protected fort; rezzed Aardvark blocks further Worm LegalActions on that fort.

mechanics.label: Bizarre Encryption Scheme Agenda Delay
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Accessed BES marks the run; later accessed agendas on that run are returned to the fort and scored for Runner at Runner turn start if still present.

mechanics.label: Chester Mix ICE Install Discount
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Rezzed Chester Mix reduces Corp ICE install costs on its fort by 1 with zero floor after taxes.

mechanics.label: Chimera Daemon Trash on Access
mechanics.currentScopeNote: Accessing Chimera opens a Runner daemon-trash choice if installed daemons exist; empty daemon state is a clean no-op.
